dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with htmlpp preprocessor, free-format source, external-form CGI extensions, and $set compiler directives. Likely part of a Brazilian ERP/WMS system (Portuguese language identifiers, decimal-point is comma).

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian warehouse/logistics system handling rental contract collection closure (Fechamento da Recolha), comodato (loan/consignment) items, controlled materials, and rental contracts with traceability.
purpose.summary: Program PW03232C implements the 'Fechamento da Recolha' (Collection Closure) process for a Brazilian logistics/rental management system. It validates and closes collection maps, processes comodato (consignment) items, checks controlled materials, and manages rental contract traceability. It operates as a CGI web program using Micro Focus htmlpp preprocessor.

notable_features: $set preprocess (htmlpp) - HTML preprocessor for CGI web output
external-form CGI input section with 'identified by' clauses
exit section / exit perform (Micro Focus extensions)
46 COPY statements for file definitions and working storage
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
